GET Items API

/osrs/items

Access the complete OSRS items database with SQLite backend, real-time wiki lookup, and icon support.

📋 Overview

The Items API provides access to over 14,000 OSRS items stored in a SQLite database with the following features:

  • Database-backed: Fast SQLite queries with 14,000+ items
  • Wiki Integration: Real-time lookup for missing items
  • Icon Support: 100% icon coverage with direct URLs
  • Pagination: Efficient pagination for large datasets
  • Search: Advanced search and filtering capabilities

🔍 List All Items

GET /osrs/items

Retrieve a paginated list of all items in the database.

Query Parameters

Parameter Type Default Description
page number 1 Page number (1-based)
max_results number 25 Number of items per page (max: 100)

Example Request

GET /osrs/items?page=1&max_results=10

🔍 Get Item by ID

GET /osrs/items/{id}

Retrieve detailed information about a specific item by its ID.

Path Parameters

Parameter Type Description
id number Item ID (e.g., 4151 for Abyssal whip)

Example Request

GET /osrs/items/4151

🔍 Search Items

GET /osrs/search/items?q={query} OR GET /osrs/search/items?id={id}

Search for items by name with fuzzy matching or by exact item ID. Both methods return items with icon data.

Query Parameters

Parameter Type Required Description
q string Yes* Search query for item name (e.g., "dragon", "sword")
id number Yes* Exact item ID to search for (e.g., 4151 for Abyssal whip)
page number No Page number for pagination (default: 1)
max_results number No Maximum results per page (default: 25)

* Either 'q' (name search) or 'id' (ID search) is required, but not both.

Example Requests

GET /osrs/search/items?q=dragon
GET /osrs/search/items?id=4151

📊 Response Format

All item endpoints return data in the following format:

{ "id": 4151, "name": "Abyssal whip", "examine": "A weapon from the abyss.", "equipable": true, "tradeable": true, "icon_path": "/icons/abyssal_whip.png", "icon_url": "https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/images/Abyssal_whip.png", "high_alch": 72000, "low_alch": 48000, "value": 72000, "members": true, "quest_item": false, "release_date": "2005-01-26", "weight": 0.453, "buy_limit": 8, "category": "Melee weapons" }

🚀 Features

  • Real-time Wiki Lookup: Missing items are automatically fetched from the OSRS Wiki
  • Icon Integration: Direct access to item icons with fallback URLs
  • Comprehensive Data: Includes examine text, tradeability, alchemy values, and more
  • Performance Optimized: SQLite database ensures fast query times
  • Error Handling: Graceful fallbacks for missing items
